title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
summary: Amazon plans to build a Texas data center with an on-site power plant that could become the largest climate pollution source in the U.S. The investment raises significant environmental concerns about the company's infrastructure expansion and the growing energy demands of large-scale data centers.
content: As part of a planned Texas data center, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could reportedly become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States.

title: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
summary: X is ending its revenue-sharing program for content creators and launching a new Original Content Rewards program on September 8th. Creators must have 500 verified followers and 500,000 impressions from verified users in the last 90 days to qualify, with revenue based on impressions from Premium subscribers.
content:
X wants to make money on previously used handles. | Image: The Verge	

X is ending its controversial revenue-sharing program for content creators, which has seen numerous revisions under Elon Musk's reign. In its place, it's launching a new Original Content Rewards program on September 8th. To be eligible, creators must have at least 500 verified followers and at least 500,000 Home Timeline impressions from verified users in the last 90 days, among other requirements.

title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
summary: OpenAI has acquired NextSlide, a presentation software startup, with the team now working on ChatGPT development. The acquisition reflects OpenAI's strategy to expand its engineering talent and product capabilities. Specific details about how NextSlide's technology will integrate into ChatGPT remain undisclosed.
content: NextSlide says its team members are now working on ChatGPT.

title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
summary: Amazon is building a natural gas power plant in Pecos County, Texas to power a new data center, which could become one of the largest single greenhouse gas producers in the US. The 35-turbine facility generating 7.65 gigawatts would initially operate independently of the state power grid, serving only the data center. This raises environmental concerns about the carbon footprint of powering large-scale AI infrastructure.
content:
To power its new West Texas data center, Amazon is investing in the construction of a new power plant that could be one of the largest single producers of greenhouse gases in the US, according to the New York Times. The new gas-burning plant in Pecos County, Texas has received significant investment from Amazon and, at least initially, would not be connected to the state's power grid. Instead, its 35 natural-gas turbines would primarily deliver its 7.65 gigawatts of electricity to the new data center.

title: The Kindle Scribe Colorsoft is a lot of fun, but it’s not a must-have
summary: The Kindle Scribe Colorsoft is an attractive and lightweight e-reader, but its premium price and form factor limit its mainstream appeal. The device targets niche users rather than representing an essential upgrade for average readers.
content: While the device is pretty and lightweight, it’s not something the everyday person needs due to its hefty price tag and size.

title: Buc-ee’s dodges John Oliver to sue another small business
summary: Buc-ee's continues its aggressive legal strategy by suing small businesses, this time targeting an Ohio competitor despite John Oliver's public challenge to pursue his merchandise parody instead. The convenience store chain has built a pattern of litigation against smaller rivals following its viral World Cup popularity.
content:
Buc-ee’s mega-convenience store and 120-pump gas station in Mount Crawford, Virginia. | Image: Chip Somodevilla / Getty Images	

Buc-ee's became something of a viral sensation during the World Cup, but it has a troubling history of suing small gas stations and convenience stores. On a recent episode of Last Week Tonight, John Oliver literally begged the company to sue him for selling merch featuring his squirrel mascot, Mr. Nutterbutter, with branding that reads "Buc-Off." But Buc-ee's has so far declined to take the bait, instead targeting yet another small business that lacks the deep pockets and legal team of HBO.

title: Google’s top hacker hunter explains why hacking groups get codenames
summary: Google recently overhauled how it names and assigns identifiers to hacking groups, and company security researchers explain the strategic importance of codenames in threat intelligence. These naming conventions help the cybersecurity community track and coordinate defense against organized hacking campaigns.
content: Google recently changed how it refers and assigns names to hacking groups. TechCrunch spoke with one of the world’s foremost experts on tracking hackers to understand why companies give hackers codenames.

title: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is building a digital music player, but don’t call it retro
summary: Musician Tom Vek is developing Sleevenote, a digital music player inspired by vinyl aesthetics but built for modern listening. The artist, known for indie electronic music and video game soundtrack work, is channeling his creative vision into hardware design.
content:
Tom, we can’t see your face. | Image: Tom Vek	

Tom Vek burst onto the scene in 2005 with his album We Have Sound, which garnered a solid 7.6 from the tastemakers of the day over at Pitchfork. His undeniably catchy brand of dancy indietronica landed him an appearance on The OC and placement on the Grand Theft Auto IV soundtrack. His follow-up, Leisure Seizure, had a lengthy gestation period, but arrived in 2011 to similar success, reaching No. 79 on the UK charts.

title: Is this $450 laptop from an unknown brand too good to be true?
summary: Chinese brand Chuwi announced a $450 Windows laptop with aluminum build and Intel's new Wildcat Lake processor, undercutting the MacBook Neo's $699 price point. However, the reviewer concludes it's too good to be true, indicating significant trade-offs in performance or build quality.
content:
Cute name, especially if it were a wookiee. | Photo: Antonio G. Di Benedetto / The Verge	

Finding a good laptop under $500 was hard enough before RAMageddon. They nearly always had cheap hardware and underpowered, often outdated chips. That's what made the MacBook Neo so disruptive: It offered great build quality and good-enough performance starting at $599. Windows laptops couldn't touch it. Even though it's gone up to $699, it's still the laptop to beat.
So when little-known Chinese brand Chuwi announced a $450 Windows laptop with an aluminum build and a brand-new Intel Wildcat Lake processor, it sounded too good to be true.

title: The first self-driving vehicle on Mars has proven to be a smashing success
summary: NASA's Perseverance rover has successfully demonstrated autonomous navigation on Mars, with approximately 90 percent of its total driving distance completed without human control. This achievement validates self-driving technology for extraterrestrial exploration.
content: About 90 percent of the distance driven by Perseverance has been autonomous.

zh.title: 火星上第一辆自驾车已被证明是巨大的成功
zh.summary: 美国航空航天局的毅力号火星车已成功演示了火星上的自主导航，约90%的总行驶距离在没有人类控制的情况下完成。这一成就验证了自驾车技术在地外探索中的应用。

title: DeepMind’s hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists
summary: DeepMind's open-source WeatherNext model can generate accurate hurricane predictions using lower-resolution weather data than traditional forecasting methods. The breakthrough has surprised meteorologists and could expand access to advanced weather prediction technology.
content: Open source WeatherNext model can make accurate predictions with lower-resolution weather data.

zh.title: DeepMind的飓风突破让气象学家感到惊讶

title: Nitecore’s latest power bank is the lightest and most compact yet
summary: The Nitecore NB10000 Gen 4 is the lightest and most compact 10,000mAh power bank available, weighing just 146 grams with minimal dimensions. At $83.95, it's purpose-built for backpackers and endurance athletes seeking to minimize gear weight.
content:
The Nitecore NB10000 Gen 4 power bank is a great option for endurance athletes and backpackers. | Photo by Thomas Ricker / The Verge	

There's two things you should know about me, your intrepid reviewer: I hate the feature creep associated with modern power banks, and I love shaving grams off the gear I carry when backpacking,  bikepacking, and trail running. So imagine my delight when Nitecore released a new generation of its ultralight NB10000 battery. After a few weeks with it I can confidently say: Haribo be damned!
